edge_nodes_status_check.name: edge_nodes_status_check
edge_nodes_status_check.value: ("edge_nodes"."status" = 'active' AND "edge_nodes"."revoked_at" IS NULL) OR ("edge_nodes"."status" = 'revoked' AND "edge_nodes"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)

edge_nodes_previous_credential_check.name: edge_nodes_previous_credential_check

edge_outbound_queue_status_check.name: edge_outbound_queue_status_check
edge_outbound_queue_status_check.value: ("edge_outbound_queue"."status" = 'pending' AND "edge_outbound_queue"."acked_at" IS NULL) OR ("edge_outbound_queue"."status" = 'acked' AND "edge_outbound_queue"."acked_at" IS NOT NULL)

sync_cursors_peer_offset_check.name: sync_cursors_peer_offset_check
sync_cursors_peer_offset_check.value: "sync_cursors"."peer_seq_offset" >= 0 AND "sync_cursors"."peer_seq_offset" <= GREATEST("sync_cursors"."acked_out_seq", "sync_cursors"."received_in_seq") AND ("sync_cursors"."peer_instance_id" IS NOT NULL OR "sync_cursors"."peer_seq_offset" = 0)

edge_print_jobs_fallback_check.name: edge_print_jobs_fallback_check

edge_printers_transport_check.name: edge_printers_transport_check

pos_order_discounts_percent_check.name: pos_order_discounts_percent_check
pos_order_discounts_percent_check.value:

pos_order_discounts_approval_pair_check.name: pos_order_discounts_approval_pair_check
pos_order_discounts_approval_pair_check.value: ("pos_order_discounts"."approved_by" IS NULL) = ("pos_order_discounts"."approval_request_id" IS NULL AND "pos_order_discounts"."override_id" IS NULL)

pos_order_refunds_approval_check.name: pos_order_refunds_approval_check

pos_order_voids_approval_check.name: pos_order_voids_approval_check
pos_order_voids_approval_check.value: "pos_order_voids"."override_id" IS NOT NULL OR "pos_order_voids"."approval_request_id" IS NOT NULL

pos_qris_holds_target_check.name: pos_qris_holds_target_check

pos_qris_holds_basis_check.name: pos_qris_holds_basis_check

pos_qris_holds_close_reason_check.name: pos_qris_holds_close_reason_check
pos_qris_holds_close_reason_check.value: ("pos_qris_holds"."close_reason" IS NULL OR "pos_qris_holds"."close_reason" IN ('provider_paid', 'provider_expired', 'provider_failed', 'provider_cancelled', 'force_released')) AND (("pos_qris_holds"."state" IN ('paid', 'closed')) = ("pos_qris_holds"."close_reason" IS NOT NULL))

pos_qris_release_reconciliations_resolve.name: pos_qris_release_reconciliations_resolved_check

payment_va_releases_kind_actor_check.name: payment_va_releases_kind_actor_check
payment_va_releases_kind_actor_check.value: ("payment_va_releases"."kind" = 'staff' AND "payment_va_releases"."released_by" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_va_releases"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_va_releases"."override_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("payment_va_releases"."kind" = 'guest_method_change' AND "payment_va_releases"."released_by" IS NULL AND "payment_va_releases"."approved_by" IS NULL AND "payment_va_releases"."override_id" IS NULL)

payment_va_releases_resolved_check.name: payment_va_releases_resolved_check
payment_va_releases_resolved_check.value: ("payment_va_releases"."status" = 'resolved') = ("payment_va_releases"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_va_releases"."resolution" IS NOT NULL)

pos_receipt_deliveries_email_check.name: pos_receipt_deliveries_email_check
pos_receipt_deliveries_email_check.value:
("pos_receipt_deliveries"."channel" <> 'email' AND "pos_receipt_deliveries"."destination_sealed" IS NULL)
        OR ("pos_receipt_deliveries"."channel" = 'email' AND ("pos_receipt_deliveries"."status" <> 'queued' OR "pos_receipt_deliveries"."destination_sealed" IS NOT NULL))

pos_receipts_void_fields_check.name: pos_receipts_void_fields_check
pos_receipts_void_fields_check.value:

        AND ("pos_receipts"."status" = 'voided' OR ("pos_receipts"."voided_at" IS NULL AND "pos_receipts"."void_reason" IS NULL AND "pos_receipts"."voided_by" IS NULL))

receipt_sequences_retired_reason_check.name: receipt_sequences_retired_reason_check
receipt_sequences_retired_reason_check.value: "receipt_sequences"."retired_reason" IS NULL OR ("receipt_sequences"."retired_at" IS NOT NULL AND "receipt_sequences"."retired_reason" IN ('claim_rotated','cloud_takeover','edge_replaced','edge_regressed'))

kitchen_ticket_status_changes_reason_che.name: kitchen_ticket_status_changes_reason_check
kitchen_ticket_status_changes_reason_che.value: "kitchen_ticket_status_changes"."to_status" NOT IN ('recalled', 'cancelled') OR "kitchen_ticket_status_changes"."reason" IS NOT NULL OR "kitchen_ticket_status_changes"."order_item_id" IS NOT NULL

order_issue_charges_cash_paid_check.name: order_issue_charges_cash_paid_check
order_issue_charges_cash_paid_check.value: "order_issue_charges"."cash_movement_id" IS NULL OR ("order_issue_charges"."status" = 'paid' AND "order_issue_charges"."payment_intent_id" IS NULL)

order_issue_charges_state_check.name: order_issue_charges_state_check
order_issue_charges_state_check.value: ("order_issue_charges"."status" = 'paid') = ("order_issue_charges"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("order_issue_charges"."status" IN ('waived', 'expired')) = ("order_issue_charges"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("order_issue_charges"."status" <> 'waived' OR ("order_issue_charges"."closed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "order_issue_charges"."close_reason" IS NOT NULL))

order_issues_resolved_item_once_idx.name: order_issues_resolved_item_once_idx
order_issues_resolved_item_once_idx.where: "order_issues"."type" = 'unfulfillable' AND "order_issues"."resolution" IS NOT NULL AND "order_issues"."status" <> 'cancelled' AND "order_issues"."refund_rejected_at" IS NULL

order_issues_staff_check.name: order_issues_staff_check
order_issues_staff_check.value: "order_issues"."type" NOT IN ('remake', 'comp') OR "order_issues"."employee_id" IS NOT NULL

order_issues_refund_approval_check.name: order_issues_refund_approval_check
order_issues_refund_approval_check.value: "order_issues"."resolution" IS DISTINCT FROM 'manual_refund' OR ("order_issues"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("order_issues"."reason_note")) >= 10)

order_issues_voucher_check.name: order_issues_voucher_check
order_issues_voucher_check.value: "order_issues"."resolution" IS DISTINCT FROM 'voucher' OR "order_issues"."voucher_id" IS NOT NULL

order_issues_swap_check.name: order_issues_swap_check
order_issues_swap_check.value: "order_issues"."resolution" IS DISTINCT FROM 'swap' OR "order_issues"."replacement_item_id" IS NOT NULL

order_issues_swap_approval_check.name: order_issues_swap_approval_check
order_issues_swap_approval_check.value: "order_issues"."resolution" IS DISTINCT FROM 'swap' OR "order_issues"."price_difference_idr" IS NULL OR "order_issues"."price_difference_idr" <= 0 OR "order_issues"."approval_request_id" IS NOT NULL

purchase_invoices_amounts_check.name: purchase_invoices_amounts_check
purchase_invoices_amounts_check.value:
"purchase_invoices"."goods_idr" >= 0 AND "purchase_invoices"."services_idr" >= 0
        AND "purchase_invoices"."ppn_idr" >= 0 AND "purchase_invoices"."pph23_idr" >= 0
        AND "purchase_invoices"."total_idr" >= 0 AND "purchase_invoices"."payable_idr" > 0
        AND "purchase_invoices"."total_idr" = "purchase_invoices"."goods_idr" + "purchase_invoices"."price_variance_idr"
          + "purchase_invoices"."services_idr" + "purchase_invoices"."ppn_idr"
        AND "purchase_invoices"."payable_idr" = "purchase_invoices"."total_idr" - "purchase_invoices"."pph23_idr"

purchase_invoices_decision_state_check.name: purchase_invoices_decision_state_check
purchase_invoices_decision_state_check.value:
("purchase_invoices"."status" IN ('released', 'rejected')) = ("purchase_invoices"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("purchase_invoices"."decided_by" IS NULL) = ("purchase_invoices"."decided_at" IS NULL)

pos_shifts_amounts_check.name: pos_shifts_amounts_check
pos_shifts_amounts_check.value:
"pos_shifts"."opening_float_idr" >= 0 AND "pos_shifts"."cash_sales_idr" >= 0
        AND "pos_shifts"."cash_refunds_idr" >= 0 AND "pos_shifts"."cash_in_idr" >= 0
        AND "pos_shifts"."cash_out_idr" >= 0 AND "pos_shifts"."cash_drop_idr" >= 0
        AND ("pos_shifts"."counted_idr" IS NULL OR "pos_shifts"."counted_idr" >= 0)

pos_shifts_open_check.name: pos_shifts_open_check
pos_shifts_open_check.value:
"pos_shifts"."status" <> 'open' OR ("pos_shifts"."expected_idr" IS NULL
        AND "pos_shifts"."counted_idr" IS NULL AND "pos_shifts"."variance_idr" IS NULL
        AND "pos_shifts"."variance_note" IS NULL AND "pos_shifts"."counts" IS NULL
        AND "pos_shifts"."approved_by" IS NULL AND "pos_shifts"."approval_request_id" IS NULL
        AND "pos_shifts"."approval_override_id" IS NULL AND "pos_shifts"."approved_at" IS NULL
        AND "pos_shifts"."closed_at" IS NULL AND "pos_shifts"."closed_by" IS NULL
        AND "pos_shifts"."close_key" IS NULL AND "pos_shifts"."close_fingerprint" IS NULL
        AND "pos_shifts"."count_id" IS NULL AND "pos_shifts"."held_cash_out_idr" = 0
        AND "pos_shifts"."difference_idr" IS NULL)

pos_shifts_closed_check.name: pos_shifts_closed_check
pos_shifts_closed_check.value:
"pos_shifts"."status" <> 'closed' OR ("pos_shifts"."expected_idr" IS NOT NULL
        AND "pos_shifts"."counted_idr" IS NOT NULL AND "pos_shifts"."variance_idr" IS NOT NULL
        AND "pos_shifts"."counts" IS NOT NULL
        AND "pos_shifts"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "pos_shifts"."approval_request_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "pos_shifts"."approval_override_id" IS NOT NULL AND "pos_shifts"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "pos_shifts"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "pos_shifts"."closed_by" IS NOT NULL
        AND "pos_shifts"."close_key" IS NOT NULL AND "pos_shifts"."close_fingerprint" IS NOT NULL
        AND "pos_shifts"."expected_idr" = "pos_shifts"."opening_float_idr" + "pos_shifts"."cash_sales_idr"
          - "pos_shifts"."cash_refunds_idr" + "pos_shifts"."cash_in_idr" - "pos_shifts"."cash_out_idr"
          - "pos_shifts"."cash_drop_idr"
        AND "pos_shifts"."variance_idr" = "pos_shifts"."counted_idr" - "pos_shifts"."expected_idr"
        AND (coalesce("pos_shifts"."difference_idr",
            "pos_shifts"."variance_idr" + "pos_shifts"."held_cash_out_idr") = 0
          OR "pos_shifts"."variance_note" IS NOT NULL))

pos_shifts_difference_check.name: pos_shifts_difference_check
pos_shifts_difference_check.value:
"pos_shifts"."difference_idr" IS NULL
        OR ("pos_shifts"."variance_idr" IS NOT NULL
          AND "pos_shifts"."difference_idr" - "pos_shifts"."variance_idr"
            BETWEEN 0 AND "pos_shifts"."held_cash_out_idr")

employee_loans_decided_pair_check.name: employee_loans_decided_pair_check
employee_loans_decided_pair_check.value:
("employee_loans"."status" <> 'pending') = ("employee_loans"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("employee_loans"."status" <> 'pending') = ("employee_loans"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

employee_loans_disbursed_check.name: employee_loans_disbursed_check
employee_loans_disbursed_check.value:
("employee_loans"."status" IN ('disbursed', 'settled')) = ("employee_loans"."disbursed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("employee_loans"."status" IN ('disbursed', 'settled') OR "employee_loans"."outstanding_idr" = "employee_loans"."principal_idr")

pay_components_kind_check.name: pay_components_kind_check
pay_components_kind_check.value: "pay_components"."kind" = CASE WHEN "pay_components"."category" IN ('late_deduction', 'loan_installment', 'bpjs_employee', 'pph21', 'pph21_receivable', 'custom_deduction') THEN 'deduction' ELSE 'earning' END

payroll_loan_policies_ceiling_check.name: payroll_loan_policies_ceiling_check
payroll_loan_policies_ceiling_check.value: "payroll_loan_policies"."max_principal_idr" IS NOT NULL OR "payroll_loan_policies"."max_principal_of_base_salary_bp" IS NOT NULL

        AND "payroll_loan_policies"."max_installments" BETWEEN 1 AND 36
        AND "payroll_loan_policies"."max_deduction_of_net_pay_bp" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000

payroll_runs_frozen_check.name: payroll_runs_frozen_check
payroll_runs_frozen_check.value:
"payroll_runs"."status" NOT IN ('locked', 'paid', 'reversed') OR ("payroll_runs"."config_snapshot" IS NOT NULL AND "payroll_runs"."totals" IS NOT NULL
        AND "payroll_runs"."approved_by_hr" IS NOT NULL AND "payroll_runs"."approved_by_hr_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "payroll_runs"."approved_by_finance" IS NOT NULL AND "payroll_runs"."approved_by_finance_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "payroll_runs"."locked_by" IS NOT NULL AND "payroll_runs"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL)

payroll_runs_paid_pair_check.name: payroll_runs_paid_pair_check
payroll_runs_paid_pair_check.value:
("payroll_runs"."status" = 'paid') = ("payroll_runs"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("payroll_runs"."status" = 'paid') = ("payroll_runs"."paid_by" IS NOT NULL)

reimbursements_decided_pair_check.name: reimbursements_decided_pair_check
reimbursements_decided_pair_check.value:
("reimbursements"."status" <> 'submitted') = ("reimbursements"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("reimbursements"."status" <> 'submitted') = ("reimbursements"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

reimbursements_run_check.name: reimbursements_run_check
reimbursements_run_check.value:
("reimbursements"."payout" = 'payroll' OR "reimbursements"."payroll_run_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("reimbursements"."status" <> 'paid' OR "reimbursements"."payout" = 'cash' OR "reimbursements"."payroll_run_id" IS NOT NULL)

service_charge_pools_approved_pair_check.name: service_charge_pools_approved_pair_check
service_charge_pools_approved_pair_check.value:
("service_charge_pools"."status" IN ('approved', 'distributed')) = ("service_charge_pools"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("service_charge_pools"."status" IN ('approved', 'distributed')) = ("service_charge_pools"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)

statutory_rates_published_pair_check.name: statutory_rates_published_pair_check
statutory_rates_published_pair_check.value:
("statutory_rates"."status" = 'published') = ("statutory_rates"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("statutory_rates"."status" = 'published') = ("statutory_rates"."published_by" IS NOT NULL)

payroll_rapels_approvers_check.name: payroll_rapels_approvers_check
payroll_rapels_approvers_check.value:

recipe_deductions_reversal_source_check.value: ("recipe_deductions"."reversed_at" IS NOT NULL OR "recipe_deductions"."reversal_failed_at" IS NOT NULL) = ("recipe_deductions"."reversal_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "recipe_deductions"."reversal_source_id" IS NOT NULL)

goods_receipt_lines_expiry_batch_check.name: goods_receipt_lines_expiry_batch_check
goods_receipt_lines_expiry_batch_check.value: "goods_receipt_lines"."expires_on" IS NULL OR "goods_receipt_lines"."batch_code" IS NOT NULL

metrics_daily_value_check.name: metrics_daily_value_check
metrics_daily_value_check.value: ("metrics_daily"."unit" IN ('idr', 'count', 'seconds') AND "metrics_daily"."value_int" IS NOT NULL AND "metrics_daily"."value_decimal" IS NULL) OR ("metrics_daily"."unit" IN ('percent', 'decimal') AND "metrics_daily"."value_decimal" IS NOT NULL AND "metrics_daily"."value_int" IS NULL)

menu_recommendation_item_rules_hours_che.name: menu_recommendation_item_rules_hours_check
menu_recommendation_item_rules_hours_che.value: ("menu_recommendation_item_rules"."hour_from" IS NULL AND "menu_recommendation_item_rules"."hour_to" IS NULL) OR ("menu_recommendation_item_rules"."hour_from" IS NOT NULL AND "menu_recommendation_item_rules"."hour_to" IS NOT NULL AND "menu_recommendation_item_rules"."hour_from" BETWEEN 0 AND 23 AND "menu_recommendation_item_rules"."hour_to" BETWEEN 0 AND 23)

ai_provider_configs_key_check.name: ai_provider_configs_key_check
ai_provider_configs_key_check.value: "ai_provider_configs"."connection_type" <> 'api_key' OR ("ai_provider_configs"."api_key_encrypted" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_provider_configs"."api_key_key_version" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_provider_configs"."api_key_last4" IS NOT NULL)

ai_provider_configs_test_check.name: ai_provider_configs_test_check
ai_provider_configs_test_check.value: "ai_provider_configs"."last_test_status" IS NULL OR "ai_provider_configs"."last_tested_at" IS NOT NULL

bill_splits_claim_redeemed_check.name: bill_splits_claim_redeemed_check
bill_splits_claim_redeemed_check.value: "bill_splits"."claim_redeemed_at" IS NULL OR "bill_splits"."claim_token_hash" IS NOT NULL

point_earn_records_points_check.name: point_earn_records_points_check
point_earn_records_points_check.value:
"point_earn_records"."computed_points" >= 0 AND "point_earn_records"."capped_points" >= 0 AND "point_earn_records"."booked_points" >= 0
          AND "point_earn_records"."reversed_points" >= 0 AND "point_earn_records"."reversed_points" <= "point_earn_records"."booked_points"
          AND "point_earn_records"."reversal_shortfall_points" >= 0
          AND "point_earn_records"."refunded_eligible_idr" >= 0 AND "point_earn_records"."refunded_eligible_idr" <= "point_earn_records"."eligible_spend_idr"

point_ledger_sign_check.name: point_ledger_sign_check
point_ledger_sign_check.value:
CASE WHEN "point_ledger"."type" IN ('earn', 'bonus') THEN "point_ledger"."points" > 0
               WHEN "point_ledger"."type" IN ('redeem', 'expire', 'reverse') THEN "point_ledger"."points" < 0
               ELSE "point_ledger"."points" <> 0 END

point_ledger_source_type_check.name: point_ledger_source_type_check
point_ledger_source_type_check.value:
CASE "point_ledger"."type"
            WHEN 'earn' THEN "point_ledger"."source_type" IN ('order', 'table_claim')
            WHEN 'bonus' THEN "point_ledger"."source_type" IN ('mission', 'referral', 'birthday', 'adjustment')
            WHEN 'redeem' THEN "point_ledger"."source_type" = 'reward_redemption'
            WHEN 'expire' THEN "point_ledger"."source_type" = 'expiry'
            WHEN 'reverse' THEN "point_ledger"."source_type" IN ('refund', 'void')
            ELSE "point_ledger"."source_type" = 'adjustment' END

point_ledger_source_id_check.name: point_ledger_source_id_check
point_ledger_source_id_check.value: "point_ledger"."type" NOT IN ('earn', 'redeem', 'reverse') OR "point_ledger"."source_id" IS NOT NULL

point_ledger_expires_check.name: point_ledger_expires_check
point_ledger_expires_check.value:
CASE WHEN "point_ledger"."type" IN ('earn', 'bonus') THEN "point_ledger"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL
               WHEN "point_ledger"."type" = 'redeem' THEN "point_ledger"."expires_at" IS NULL
               ELSE true END

point_ledger_adjust_check.name: point_ledger_adjust_check
point_ledger_adjust_check.value:
"point_ledger"."type" <> 'adjust' OR (
            "point_ledger"."reason" IS NOT NULL
            AND ("point_ledger"."reverses_entry_id" IS NULL OR "point_ledger"."expires_at" IS NULL)
            AND ("point_ledger"."reverses_entry_id" IS NOT NULL OR "point_ledger"."points" < 0 OR "point_ledger"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL))

missions_window_check.name: missions_window_check
missions_window_check.value: "missions"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "missions"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "missions"."ends_at" > "missions"."starts_at"

rewards_type_shape_check.name: rewards_type_shape_check
rewards_type_shape_check.value:
CASE WHEN "rewards"."type" = 'voucher'
               THEN "rewards"."voucher_value_idr" IS NOT NULL AND "rewards"."voucher_value_idr" > 0 AND "rewards"."menu_item_id" IS NULL
               ELSE "rewards"."menu_item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "rewards"."voucher_value_idr" IS NULL END

feedback_session_profile_kind_key.name: feedback_session_profile_kind_key
feedback_session_profile_kind_key.where: "feedback"."order_id" IS NULL AND "feedback"."table_session_id" IS NOT NULL

feedback_kind_shape_check.name: feedback_kind_shape_check
feedback_kind_shape_check.value:
CASE WHEN "feedback"."kind" = 'rating'
               THEN "feedback"."rating" IS NOT NULL
               ELSE "feedback"."comment" IS NOT NULL END

menu_costs_complete_check.name: menu_costs_complete_check
menu_costs_complete_check.value:
("menu_costs"."recipe_complete" AND "menu_costs"."recipe_id" IS NOT NULL AND "menu_costs"."theoretical_cost_idr" IS NOT NULL AND "menu_costs"."gross_margin_bp" IS NOT NULL)
        OR (NOT "menu_costs"."recipe_complete" AND "menu_costs"."theoretical_cost_idr" IS NULL AND "menu_costs"."gross_margin_bp" IS NULL)

reservation_dp_remainder_kind_check.name: reservation_dp_remainder_kind_check
reservation_dp_remainder_kind_check.value: "reservation_deposit_remainders"."kind" IN ('customer_credit','manual_refund') AND ("reservation_deposit_remainders"."kind" <> 'customer_credit' OR "reservation_deposit_remainders"."customer_profile_id" IS NOT NULL)

ai_chatgpt_connections_consent_check.name: ai_chatgpt_connections_consent_check
ai_chatgpt_connections_consent_check.value: NOT "ai_chatgpt_connections"."enabled" OR ("ai_chatgpt_connections"."risk_accepted_by" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_chatgpt_connections"."risk_accepted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_chatgpt_connections"."model" IS NOT NULL)
